title: trisetum cavanillesii
intro: Trisetum cavanillesii, commonly known as Spanish Needle Grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum cavanillesii include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, a bronchodilator, and a mucolytic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
